notes.title: Update They Are Beasts to version 0.3.00
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35221900/7d15a116067db2387464787de0d9be4d8222b599.png[/img]

-Added new weapons: Grenade launcher and Hellgun.
-Changed the system for generating enemies in Story mode
-The store can be used directly during the passage of the level.
-Changed the balance of the mode "Survival"
-In the "Survival" mode, objects no longer appear in random places.
-In the "Survival" mode, items drop when the enemies die.
-Changed the balance of enemies.

notes.title: Update They Are Beasts to version 0.2.34
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35221900/b5392b3dc8c6fdb90d2d606c7daec76a825e1026.png[/img]

-Added new weapons: Revolver "Python"
-Changed the hit tracking system (Some weapons penetrate enemies right through)
-Changed the characteristics of some weapons
-Fixed bug with passing enemies through walls in generated maps
-Removed slow zombies
-Slowed the movement speed of zombies
